To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

virgin olive oil has short-term effects on oxidant/ antioxidant status and that these effects are associated with changes in lipid peroxidation and glutathione peroxide and glutathione redutase activities.
virgin olive oil ingestion increases plasma oleic acid, improves the resistance of LDL to oxidative modification and increases plasma glutathione-related enzymatic activities.

a single dose of olive oil and a 1-wks consumption of olive oil increase plasma oleic acid and resistance of LDL cholesterol to oxidation and increase the activities of glutathione perioxidase and glutathione redutase.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the short-term effects of virgin olive oil on plasma oxidant/antoxidant status and its lipid profile.
the postprandial and 1-wk effects of virgin olive oil on the oxidant/antoxidant status and lipid profile in healthy humans.
the effects of a single dose and a short-term dietary intervention with virgin olive oil on the oxidative status.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
virgin olive oil has short-term benefits for oxidant/antoxidant status.
virgin olive oil is a good source of monounsaturated fatty acids and that its consumption may have beneficial effects in oxidative stress and lipid profile.
virgin olive oil has beneficial effects on the oxidant/antoxidant balance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the consumption of virgin olive oil has a beneficial effect on the lipid profile and on oxidant/ antioxidant status.
virgin olive oil is able to induce an antioxidant effect on plasma and LDL, and that this effect is more evident after a week of daily intake.
virgin olive oil is not a panacea but it is an interesting food for its beneficial effects on lipid profile, oxidative stress biomarkers, and resistance of LDL cholesterol to oxidation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
olive oil consumption is a safe and healthy practice, and it has been shown to have beneficial effects on oxidative status.
virgin olive oil, which contains a high proportion of oleic acid, has a beneficial effect on LDL resistance to oxidation.
virgin olive oil, when ingested, has an antioxidant effect, and it is not just the antioxidants in virgin olive oil that are beneficial.
